newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures expand losses, hit lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures expand losses, hit lows.

text.p: Dec 31 - U.S. stock index futures expanded losses and touched day's lows as T-bond futures eroded again into their early close. March S&P 500s found support near 754.20, with more support seen at 752.55. They said pit half full, locals dominant. Some figured position-squaring late could trim losses. Stock index futures close at regular time Tuesday. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
